ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity dominance; approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Small, high-intensity white circular blobs scattered across both lobes; concentration is highest near the median notch and the inner-trailing edge of the right lobe (approximate coordinates relative to fluke center).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 5% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; approximately 10-12 distinct peaks visible per lobe, increasing in prominence towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge sweep leading to tapered, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, complex multi-tonal (white/brown) pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; isolated white circular pixels on the ventral surface consistent with individual scar points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present as irregular masses at both distal tips; minor irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of brownish-toned biological matter (barnacles) extending beyond the continuous geometric boundary of the fluke tips.
